items.title: Vercel token scanning expands to more public sources
items.summary: Vercel has partnered with  to expand automated detection and revocation of publicly exposed Vercel tokens.Truffle SecurityRevoking exposed credentials helps prevent unauthorized access to your projects and unexpected costs from unauthorized use of services such as  and . If your token is revoked, you’ll receive an email from us explaining why.Vercel SandboxVercel AI GatewayTruffle Security reports tokens exposed in public sources including GitHub, GitLab, Docker, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face, Android APKs, and Firefox Add-ons. Vercel has revoked hundreds of tokens reported by Truffle Security.A separate Vercel scanner now checks each new monthly  dataset of public web pages and automatically revokes any exposed Vercel tokens it finds.Common CrawlLearn more about creating tokens, setting their scopes, and managing them in the .access token documentationRead more
